title: Juicy Crisp Mexican Pork Tacos
description: A sweet and crisp Mexican dish featuring pork, buns, and fresh ingredients, perfect for a crowd, this recipe is a raw-friendly and brine-dry method for preparing delicious tacos. The combination of flavors and textures makes it a crowd-pleaser.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice, olive oil, garlic, cumin, and chili powder.
Add the pork shoulder to the bowl and coat with the marinade.
Let the pork marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the pork from the marinade and place it on a baking sheet.
Bake the pork in the preheated oven for 20 minutes per pound, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the pork is cooking, warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Once the pork is cooked, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly.
Assemble the tacos by placing sliced pork onto a warmed tortilla, and topping with salsa, cilantro, and onions.
